payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all pairs, derive the third card that completes a set using complement rules, count occurrences via hash map lookups, and divide by 3 for triple counts.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a Counter (hash map) to store frequencies of all cards, then for each pair (i,j) computes the required third card and adds its count from the map. This is a classic use of hash maps for O(n^2) complement lookup.
